content.title: Akamai Technologies’s (NASDAQ:AKAM) Q3 Sales Top Estimates, Stock Soars
content.summary: Cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5% year on year to $1.05 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $1.08 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.86 per share was 13.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
